summary: The PR addresses the issue of the caplog fixture not restoring the log level after a test, but it introduces a hardcoded value for the handler level restoration.

issues.description: The change sets the handler level to logging.NOTSET, which might not be the correct initial level for all handlers. This could lead to unexpected behavior if the handler was initially set to a different level.
The docstring for the _finalize method has an unnecessary trailing space.
